description: What the Texas HHSC OIG Medicaid Provider Exclusions data covers and how current it is: total exclusions ever recorded, how many are currently excluded vs. reinstated, how many carry an NPI or license number, how many distinct occupations appear, the oldest and newest exclusion dates, and when this pack's copy was captured. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line notes on the free-text reason field and the ever-vs-currently-excluded distinction. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 13,000+ row list, not a page — answers "how many Texas HHSC OIG exclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (excluded_since / HHSC's StartDate — never added_date, which answers a different question and gives a different number). Sourced from the Texas HHSC OIG Exclusions Database File, keyless.

end_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with start_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

start_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with end_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

year.description: Count records whose date field falls in this calendar year (e.g. 2025), counted over the WHOLE list, not a page. Ignored if start_date/end_date are given.
